breaking.change: `value` is a percentage from 0 to 100, as NSH base's and gpui-base's progress bars take it, where it was a fraction from 0 to 1: a bar given 0.5 now draws half a percent.
breaking.fix: Multiply the value by 100 (`value={hp() / max * 100}`). `og upgrade` rewrites a `<Progress value={x}>` on one line to `value={(x) * 100}`.

added.member: Checkbox, Radio, RadioGroup, Switch, Tab, Tabs, Toggle, ToggleGroup, Toolbar, ToolbarSeparator, Slider, NumberInput (ui/controls)
added.summary: The built-in controls ported from NSH base: each owns its presses, keys, states and role for screen readers, and leaves its look to the pack's slots (`Checkbox.indicator`, `Radio.indicator`, `Switch.track` and `Switch.thumb`, `Tab.item` and `Tab.mark`, `Toggle.item`, `ToggleGroup.frame`, `Toolbar.frame`, `Slider.track`, `Slider.range` and `Slider.thumb`, `NumberInput.frame`, `NumberInput.field` and `NumberInput.step`). Tabs, RadioGroup, ToggleGroup and Toolbar are one Tab stop whose arrows move among their items; a segmented control is a ToggleGroup with one toggle pressed.

rune-kit's variants and sizes: `variant` takes neutral (the default), primary, danger, warning, contrast, outline, ghost, ghost-muted and ghost-faint (`quiet` is ghost-muted), `size` sm, md or lg (each 44 px tall or more; `small` is sm), and `selected` and `busy` states (a busy button shows the pack's `Button.spinner`). Every variant and state is the pack's `Button.plate.<variant>` slot; a theme with button art keeps the variants that have no art of their own on their own plate.
`indeterminate`: a bar whose extent is unknown, with no value for screen readers and the pack's `Progress.indeterminate` indicator. Its track is the `Progress.track` slot.
`invalid`: a control whose value fails the game's checks; screen readers say so and `aria-invalid:` classes apply.
`scheme-normal` returns an element to its parent's scheme over a `scheme-dark` or `scheme-light` an earlier class or slot set.
